title: Worklist tile counts: once per tile, no total, filtered
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin (Settings Service), on the build under test. These are number and date accuracy cases: seed the exact inputs, read the produced value back, and compare it to the stated value - never eyeball, never accept "a number".
  2. Seed rows with day intervals and BLANK last service dates (a date typed at enrolment rests the row until its first reminder, so it would not be listed): a schedule "Tile check" with "D10" Every 10 days, "D20" Every 20 days, "D45" Every 45 days, "D80" Every 80 days and "NR" Every 30 days + Distance Every 15,000 mileage; enrol two test assets on it with blank dates (asset 2 must have no mileage reading so NR is a Needs readings row). For Overdue rows enrol a third asset on a schedule "Late check" with "L30" Every 30 days and last service date 100 days before today (it fell due 70 days ago and has missed several 30-day cycles; its reminder is reached, so it is listed). Add "D60" Every 60 days to "Late check" and leave its last service date blank at enrolment, so the third asset has one row Overdue (L30) and one row due in 60 days (Due in 3 months).
  3. A two-workplace organization with assets whose last work order was at each workplace (for step 4).
custom_steps:
1. Read each tile's count and the table row count, and check whether the tiles sum to the table total.
  2. Confirm the asset with rows in two tiles is counted once in each.
  3. Find the multi-cycle-overdue service and confirm it is one row counted once.
  4. Apply the location filter to one workplace and re-read every tile count.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each tile counts assets; an asset with rows in two tiles counts once in each, so the tile counts do not sum to the table row count.
  • A service appears once however many cycles it missed, and is counted once.
  • With the location filter applied, each tile counts only what that filter shows.
